expectedText: Harris Piano Jazz Bar has become synonymous with Krakow’s vibrant nightlife and is considered the birthplace of Polish jazz. Both tourists and locals adore this popular hangout place because of its inviting atmosphere and outstanding musicians who perform each evening.
markup: Harris Piano Jazz Bar lists its address as Rynek Glowny 28 and says it opened in January 1997. The operator describes a programme spanning jazz and other styles. Check its current event information or contact the venue for your date rather than assuming every performance is the same.

expectedText: Nestled within a charming cellar space, Piec Art Acoustic Jazz Club offers an intimate setting perfect for enjoying live performances from both local talents and international artists. Don’t be surprised if you find yourself tapping your feet or swaying along with the soulful tunes that fill this beloved spot.
markup: PIEC Art describes a cocktail bar and separate cellar concert and bar spaces. Its own page carries dated events: check the programme, the room and the ticket arrangements for the performance you want. An evening in the bar is not automatically the same as attending a concert.

expectedText: Krakow is home to some of the most legendary jazz bars in Poland, including Harris Piano Jazz Bar, considered the birthplace of Polish jazz. And notable venues include places like Piec Art Acoustic Jazz Club, which offers intimate settings for live performances from local and international musicians. Don’t forget to arrive early at popular shows and keep an eye on event calendars for up-and-coming artists.
markup: Compare the actual programme before choosing a jazz evening. Harris and PIEC Art publish their own venue information; confirm the event, admission and any seating reservation directly. A club's reputation or a past concert does not tell you who is playing on your visit.

expectedText: U Muniaka is a jazz institution in Krakow, known for its lively atmosphere and top-notch musicians. The club has been around since the 1950s and has hosted some of the biggest names in the Polish music scene. With its vibrant energy and impressive history, U Muniaka is a must-visit for any jazz enthusiast.
markup: Jazz Club u Muniaka publishes its programme at Florianska 3. Choose the performance for your visit and check the current admission details. Its reservation terms distinguish a ticket reservation from a reserved seat, so confirm the seating arrangement you need rather than assuming entry includes a table.

expectedText: Krakow boasts a diverse range of nightlife options, catering to all tastes and preferences. Whether you’re a jazz enthusiast or seeking alternative entertainment, the city has something for everyone. For an authentic jazz experience, head to Harris Piano Jazz Bar, the birthplace of Polish jazz. Alternatively, Piec Art Acoustic Jazz Club offers exceptional live performances in an intimate setting.
markup: Start with the music you want to hear and compare the venue's current programme. Harris, PIEC Art and U Muniaka provide their own information; check the date, admission and seating arrangements before committing to the evening.

expectedText: To make the most of Krakow’s vibrant nightlife scene, consider booking a tour with Krawl Through Krakow. Enjoy an unforgettable evening filled with music, drinks, and fun!
markup: For a broader night out, see our Krakow nightlife overview. If you prefer a group bar-and-club evening, compare the current Krakow pub-crawl inclusions; a pub-crawl booking is not a jazz-concert ticket or a reserved seat at these venues.
